<translate>
'''Kaioken''' is a '''stack form''': it layers on top of your current transformation instead of replacing it, adding its own multiplier at the cost of your '''health'''. A Saiyan can be in base form or Super Saiyan and also be in Kaioken x2 at the same time. Every race can learn it from [[Special:MyLanguage/King Kai|King Kai]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Learning Kaioken ==

[[Special:MyLanguage/King Kai|King Kai]] teaches the '''Kaioken''' skill. Each level of the skill unlocks the next tier and is bought with Training Points:
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate>Tier</translate> !! <translate>Skill level</translate> !! <translate>TP cost</translate> !! <translate>STR / SKP / PWR</translate> !! <translate>DEF</translate> !! <translate>Speed</translate> !! <translate>Health drain</translate>
|-
| x2 || 1 || 1,000 || 1.1 || 1.125 || 1.1 || 0.033
|-
| x3 || 2 || 1,500 || 1.2 || 1.25 || 1.2 || 0.072
|-
| x4 || 3 || 2,500 || 1.35 || 1.4375 || 1.35 || 0.128
|-
| x10 || 4 || 4,000 || 1.5 || 1.625 || 1.5 || 0.165
|-
| x20 || 5 || 7,500 || 1.65 || 1.8125 || 1.65 || 0.248
|}

<translate>
Multipliers are the defaults at 0% mastery and grow up to 1.5 times at 100% mastery. The health drain is the base upkeep per tick; the real cost scales with your Power Release, your offense and your health pool, and mastery discounts it (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Transformations#Energy consumption while transformed|energy consumption]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Using Kaioken ==

* Pick a Kaioken tier in the '''Stack Skills''' slice of the '''X''' menu and charge it with '''G''', like a normal form. '''Alt + G''' removes the stack form first when you descend.
* To stack Kaioken on a transformation, your current form needs at least '''25% mastery''' (the Kaioken tier itself needs none); otherwise Kaioken is dropped when you transform.
* Stacking multiplies the drain of '''both''' your form and Kaioken (×2 with the default forms), so a stacked transformation burns Ki and health fast.
* By default Kaioken's multipliers '''add up''' with those of your form instead of multiplying them.
* Kaioken shows its own red aura on a separate layer, on top of your form's aura.
* You can't stack Kaioken on the Saiyan [[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan#False Super Saiyan|False Super Saiyan]] form.
</translate>

<translate>
== Mastery ==

Each Kaioken tier has its own mastery, and every tier passes '''25%''' of the mastery it gains to the next tier up, so training a lower tier also prepares the next one. Unlike race forms, a Kaioken tier needs no mastery of its own to be stacked: only the form under it needs 25%.
</translate>

<translate>
== Related techniques and fusions ==

* King Kai also teaches the '''Kaioken Attack''' strike technique (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Strike Attacks|Strike Attacks]]).
* For the [[Special:MyLanguage/Fusion Dance|Fusion Dance]], both players must be in the same form '''and''' the same stack form, for example both Super Saiyan 2 with Kaioken.
</translate>

<translate>
== Configuration ==
</translate>
<translate>
The Kaioken tiers are defined in <code>config/dragonminez/forms/kaioken.json</code>, and the skill's TP costs in <code>skills.json</code>.
</translate>
